hero.headline:
Hope Begins
With You
hero.subtext: Donate With Hope Foundation connects generous donors worldwide with verified charitable causes in Pakistan — food, healthcare, education, and emergency relief, delivered with complete transparency.

appeal.label: Urgent Appeal
appeal.title: Flood Relief — Southern Punjab
appeal.text: Thousands of families are without shelter or clean water. Your donation today provides emergency food, medical care, and temporary shelter.

campaigns.title: Emergency Surgeries for Children
campaigns.description: Fund life-saving surgeries for children from low-income families across Punjab and Sindh.

campaigns.title: Monthly Ration for 500 Families
campaigns.description: Provide a full month of staple food supplies to families facing food insecurity.

campaigns.title: School Fees & Supplies for Orphans
campaigns.description: Sponsor a full academic year of tuition, books, and uniforms for a child in need.

campaigns.title: Flood Relief — Southern Punjab
campaigns.description: Deliver shelter, clean water, and emergency supplies to families displaced by flooding.

trust.heading: Every rupee is tracked, every story is real
trust.text: Every family and patient we support is verified in person before funds are released. Monthly and annual reports show exactly where donations go, and our on-ground volunteer network is trained and accountable at every step.

news.title: Winter Relief Reaches 1,200 Families in Sindh
news.text: Blankets, warm clothing, and fuel vouchers distributed across four districts.

news.title: New Scholarship Track Opens for Girls in STEM
news.text: Fifty scholarships now available for secondary school students.

news.title: Volunteer Training Day, Lahore Chapter
news.text: New field volunteers will complete orientation ahead of the Qurbani campaign.
